DA.Title: Dominion Aetherics Sheet
DA.LibrarySettingsHint: Browse and configure the shared four-level Active Aether and Power graph.
DA.LibraryGraphHelp: The full shared catalog: four Active Aether levels on the left, Powers on the right. Hover to see links; click to pin a node and inspect its rules below. Editing uses the small buttons. Actor grants and active selections stay separate.
DA.LibraryInspectHelp: Click an Active Aether or Power to inspect its requirements and connected entries.
DA.LibraryHelp: Shared Active Aether definitions and SWADE Power templates. Library entries grant nothing automatically. Use Active Aether Manager to assign this Actor’s choices.
DA.AssignmentHelp: Choose this Actor’s Active Aethers. Only granted entries appear in the four level columns. Removing a prerequisite also deactivates dependent higher levels and their managed passives on this Actor:
DA.InvalidAssignment: Choose valid Active Aethers from Global Library.
DA.ElementNotAssigned: The GM has not assigned this Active Aether to this Actor.
DA.NoLibraryElements: No Active Aethers in Global Library yet.
DA.NoLibraryPowers: No global Power templates yet. Create a Power or import an existing one.
DA.PowerUUID: Or a Power UUID (Actor or compendium)
DA.UseLibraryPower: Choose a global Power template from the library.
DA.PowerAdded: Power added to this Actor (existing library copies are not duplicated).
DA.MissingImage: Image unavailable; check its Forge asset path
DA.DeleteElementConfirm: Delete this global Active Aether? Active selections and dependent higher levels will deactivate. Powers or Active Aethers referencing it stay locked until reconfigured. Item data is preserved.
DA.RegistryHelp: Active Aether definitions are shared; assignments and active selections belong to each Actor.
DA.NoElements: No Active Aethers assigned to this Actor. The GM can choose them in Active Aether Manager.
DA.NoPowers: No powers in this group. Add a Power using the system control above.
DA.NoActivePassives: Activate an assigned Active Aether to display its passives.
DA.GraphHelp: Activate Active Aethers from level 1 to 4, left to right. Higher levels may require active lower levels. Click an available Power on the right to open SWADE Tools. Hover a node to see connections.
DA.ToolsRequired: Enable SWADE Tools (swade-tools-fix 2.2.4 or a compatible version) to use powers from this graph. Its casting interface must be ready; the system chat card will not be opened instead.
DA.Name: Name
DA.MechanicalPassive: Managed Active Effect; applied while this Active Aether is selected.
DA.EffectHelp: Add a correctly configured Foundry/SWADE Active Effect. The GM-approved snapshot applies once per source UUID while any providing Active Aether is selected. Timers are not copied. Remove/re-add the source to refresh its snapshot.
DA.EffectUUID: Or paste an Active Effect UUID (world or compendium)
DA.Configured: This Power has Active Aether requirements
DA.ElementMatch: How should these Active Aethers match?
DA.MatchAll: AND — all selected Active Aethers required
DA.MatchAny: OR — any one selected Active Aether is enough
DA.AnyRequiresElement: Select at least one Active Aether for an OR group.
DA.RecipeHelp: Choose AND for Water + Earth together, or OR when Water alone or Earth alone is enough. Extra groups are alternatives (OR). A configured empty AND group explicitly means always available, subject to forbidden/exact rules. Uncheck configuration to mark the power Unconfigured.
DA.ExactHelp: Extra active selections are normally allowed. Exact mode requires the active set to equal one valid combination.
DA.InvalidRecipe: This Power references a removed Active Aether or invalid requirements. The GM must reconfigure it.
DA.PowerLocked: This Power’s Active Aether requirements are not satisfied.
DA.GMOnly: Only a GM can configure global Active Aethers, assignments and Power requirements.
DA.NoPermission: You do not have the required document ownership permission.
DA.InvalidActor: Select a SWADE character or NPC Actor.
DA.WrongActor: This Power does not belong to the selected Actor.
DA.ElementNameRequired: An Active Aether name is required (maximum 100 characters).
DA.InvalidImage: Use a Foundry image path or an HTTPS image URL.
DA.InvalidPassive: Each descriptive passive needs a title and description.
DA.InvalidEffect: Select an existing Active Effect or enter its valid UUID.
DA.ManagedSource: Choose an original source effect, not a module-managed copy.
DA.RelatedEffectSource: This status effect automatically creates related effects. Use independent passive effects and assign each component separately so their removal can be tracked safely.
DA.InvalidSelection: Selection contains an unknown Active Aether ID.
DA.SelectionLimit: The GM allows at most {count} active selections.
DA.InvalidRequirements: Provide at least one valid combination, without removed, duplicate, conflicting or unknown Active Aether IDs.
DA.InvalidSchema: Active Aether data uses an unsupported schema. Restore a compatible module version.
DA.UnsupportedVersion: Dominion Aetherics requires Foundry V13 and SWADE exactly 5.1.0. The optional sheet was not registered; existing sheets are unaffected.
DA.UnsupportedTemplate: The installed SWADE Powers template is incompatible. Showing the original sheet contents.
DA.MaxActiveHelp: 0 allows unlimited selections. A positive number sets a world limit.
DA.SeparateUnconfigured: Show unconfigured powers in a separate group
DA.Connections: Show connections on hover or focus
DA.PrerequisiteHelp: Optional: require lower-level Active Aethers to be active. Level 2 may require level 1; level 3 may require levels 1/2; level 4 may require levels 1/2/3. Leave unchecked for no prerequisites. Turning a required selection off also turns off dependent higher levels.
DA.InvalidAetherLevel: Choose an Active Aether level from 1 to 4.
DA.InvalidAetherPrerequisites: Select valid lower-level prerequisites, or turn prerequisites off.
DA.MissingAetherPrerequisite: A required Active Aether was removed. Reconfigure this entry.
DA.AetherLowerLevelsOnly: Prerequisites must belong to strictly lower levels; self and same/higher-level references are not allowed.
DA.AetherLevelInUse: Another Active Aether requires this entry at a lower level. Update its prerequisites before changing this level.
DA.AetherPrerequisitesNotMet: Activate the required lower-level Active Aethers first.
